name: number-field
description: A number input with − and + buttons, for quantities, amounts, percentages and other values the user adjusts by steps. Arrow keys step it too, it stays between minValue and maxValue, and formatOptions show currency, percent or units in the user's locale. Compose the parts inside NumberField: NumberFieldLabel, NumberFieldInput (the input between its buttons), NumberFieldDescription and NumberFieldError (renders only while the value is invalid), all exported from the number-field file. For numbers that are really text, such as a phone number, a card number or a code, use a text-field.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the form submits the number without formatting.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new number once it is committed: on a step, or when the user leaves the field. NaN when it is empty.

props.name: minValue
props.description: The smallest allowed value; − is disabled there.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: The largest allowed value; + is disabled there.

props.name: step
props.description: How much each button press or arrow key changes the value; typed values snap to it.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: How the number is shown, e.g. { style: "currency", currency: "USD" } or { style: "percent" }.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Requires a value before the form submits.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Prevents changes and dims the field.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the value invalid from outside, e.g. after a server error.

props.name: validate
props.type: (value: number) => string | string[] | true | null | undefined
props.description: Returns an error message for an invalid value, shown by NumberFieldError.

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: native validates on form submit; aria validates once the value is committed.

example:
<NumberField name="quantity" defaultValue={1} minValue={1} maxValue={10}>
  <NumberFieldLabel>Quantity</NumberFieldLabel>
  <NumberFieldInput />
  <NumberFieldDescription>Up to 10 per order.</NumberFieldDescription>
</NumberField>
